note: From the Louisiana Secretary of State's candidate list and sample ballots for all 66 Vermilion Parish precincts; the District Attorney race is the only local item on every precinct ballot. Unopposed candidates were declared elected and do not appear on the ballot: 15th Judicial District Court Election Section 5 Divisions C and G, Abbeville and Kaplan City Court judges, Abbeville City Marshal, and most School Board seats. Vermilion Parish Police Jury seats are not on this ballot. Not shown because they depend on where you live: Kaplan City Court marshal; Abbeville City Council District A; School Board Districts C and F; Justices of the Peace and Constables; Consolidated Gravity Drainage District No. 1 and Hospital Service District No. 3 renewals; and town races in Erath, Maurice and Gueydan. 'No Party' candidates are shown as Independent. Incumbency is not marked because the official list does not indicate it. Check your official sample ballot.
